row.evidence: Greenhouse's 'Configure SCIM for Okta' article says "Product tier: Available for Plus and Pro subscription tiers", and the pricing page's feature table lists Automated user management for Plus and Pro but not Core.
row.notes: Unchanged status (gated). All three plans (Core, Plus, Pro) are quote-only. The pricing page's feature table marks 'Automated user management' as not in Core and included in Plus and Pro, and Greenhouse's Okta SCIM article says 'Available for Plus and Pro subscription tiers'; the Entra article still uses the old tier names (Advanced and Expert). SSO is on all plans (Core). SCIM creates, updates and deactivates users only: no group provisioning and no delete (users can never be deleted in Greenhouse). June's '~$6,500/yr starting' Core figure is not on any Greenhouse page and is dropped. Harvest API v3 (OAuth client credentials) is on all plans; v1/v2 retired 31 Aug 2026. Audit log API is Pro-only.

auth.token_source: Configure > Dev Center > SCIM Configuration > enable SCIM > Generate token
auth.notes: Method inferred from Okta 'API Token' and Entra 'Secret Token' fields; base URL is shown in the SCIM Configuration page but its pattern is not documented.

deprovision.data_retained: Users are deactivated, never deleted; their historical responsibilities are preserved and shown struck through.

custom.how: urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:extension:greenhouse:2.0:CustomField:<field_key> (single select, multi-select in Okta, yes/no, user fields)

attributes.notes: Okta guide puts firstName/lastName/employeeNumber and the department/office ID arrays in the core 2.0 User namespace; Entra guide uses name.givenName/name.familyName and the enterprise employeeNumber.

limitations.text: SSO with the same IdP must already be configured before SCIM.
Users only, no Groups; delete is not supported (deactivate only).
Users deactivated in the IdP before SCIM was set up are not automatically deactivated.
Entra ID uses a custom (non-gallery) app; users are matched on email (userPrincipalName).
Generating a new token replaces the old one and SCIM stops until the IdP is updated.
Custom fields via Entra are single-valued only.

endpoints.purpose: Grant a Job Admin role on a job

rate_limits.text: Fixed 30-second windows (X-RateLimit-* headers, 429 with Retry-After); the per-window number is not stated in the guide.

limitations.text: Harvest v1/v2 (API key) retired after 31 Aug 2026; v3 uses OAuth client credentials with expiring JWTs.
Users cannot be deleted, only deactivated.

okta.notes: OIN page ticks SAML, SCIM, Create, Update, Deactivate (no Group Push), read from page markup.

entra.notes: Gallery app is SSO only (Microsoft: provisioning is manual); Greenhouse's SCIM guide uses a custom app with the Greenhouse base URL and token.

google.notes: Greenhouse documents Google SSO with JIT account creation; no Google provisioning documented.

onelogin.notes: Greenhouse says OneLogin offers a preconfigured integration; OneLogin page not loaded and no OneLogin SCIM guide found.

fallbacks.other_sync: HRIS Link user sync (Workday, UKG Pro) on Pro with the HRIS Link add-on
